csv_project_name: CM/GC Service for Cottonwood Canyons Bus Improvements
csv_agency: Utah Department of Transportation, Constr Division
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Utah Division of Facilities Construction and Management (DFCM) is requesting proposals for Construction Manager / General Contractor (CM/GC) services for the following project The Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT) is seeking to design and construct a mobility hub at the mouth of Big Cottonwood Canyon. This hub will consist of a 1,750-car parking garage, 75 employee parking stalls, bus parking, a bus transit center, and other facilities to support the bus operation. Initial programming, basis of design, slope stability report, and preliminary geotechnical report have been completed. VCBO Architecture and team have been selected to provide the design
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management

services: Construction Manager / General Contractor (CM/GC) services for transportation facilities; project includes coordination with the selected design team led by VCBO Architecture.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a CM/GC procurement, not a direct structural design tender.
- Main scope is a parking garage and bus mobility hub rather than a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Large project value may imply some structural complexity, but no notable spans, innovative structural systems, or lightweight/special structures are described.
- Could offer indirect teaming opportunities, yet the notice does not explicitly seek structural engineering services from bidders.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or engineering fee is stated. The notice is for CM/GC services with a contract value of 99.5 million USD and a total construction cost of 188.4 million USD, but no separate structural engineering fee can be derived reliably.
